title: WS scheme check: lowercase entire URL to check two-byte prefix
description: ws/mod.rs line 156: connect_ws lowercases the entire ws_url string just to check whether it starts with 'ws://' or 'wss://'. This allocates a full copy of the URL to read its first 3-6 bytes. The codebase already depends on url::Url for base_url validation; parse the WS URL the same way and call .scheme() instead. Rewrite: let parsed = url::Url::parse(ws_url)?; match parsed.scheme() { "ws" | "wss" => {} _ => return Err(InvalidArgument(...)) }.
